data.title: 霍尔海雅 · 借来的那页
data.description: 她将书举到你们之间，等你读完也没有移开，只从书页上方看着你，慢悠悠追问答案。
data.action: 举书靠近，从书页上方注视镜头
data.camera: 近景，人物神态与互动清晰
data.promptProse: Sitting intimately close across a polished walnut reading table in a private archive, Ho'olheyak tilts a heavy gilt-edged codex just low enough to meet the viewer's eyes with an enigmatic, teasing smile. Warm amber light from a fringed reading lamp illuminates the fine print of ancient script, soft dust motes, and the playful challenge in her glowing aqua eyes.
